config.detail: No HF config. Not distributed on Hugging Face: the model ships inside the silero-vad PyPI wheel / GitHub repo (src/silero_vad/data/silero_vad.jit). Geometry read from the TorchScript code: STFT filter_length 256, hop 128, ReflectionPad1d((0, 64)); context_size_samples 64; 512-sample frames at 16 kHz; encoder 4x SileroVadBlock(Conv1d k3 p1, strides 1,2,2,1, ReLU); LSTMCell(128, 128); Dropout, ReLU, Conv1d(128, 1, 1), Sigmoid.

preprocessor.detail: STFT is a conv1d with forward_basis_buffer [258, 1, 256]: rows 0..128 = periodic-Hann * cos(2 pi k n / 256), rows 129..257 = -periodic-Hann * sin(...) (checked to 7.7e-8). Magnitude sqrt(re^2 + im^2); phase computed and discarded.

safetensors_metadata.detail: fp32 throughout: 16 tensors under _model.* (16 kHz, 309,633 params) and 16 under _model_8k.* (8 kHz, unused).

reference_modeling_code.detail: Upstream's own Python package (https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad, tag v6.2.3, commit 5cd7945). silero_vad.jit sha256 e1122837f4154c511485fe0b9c64455f7b929c96fbb8d79fbdb336383ebd3720, unchanged since tag v6.2.

dtype.evidence: Every tensor in silero_vad.jit state_dict() is torch.float32.

upstream_benchmarks.notes: Upstream publishes ROC-AUC / accuracy plots on private data only. Acceptance is per-frame probability and speech-segment parity with the reference package, not a published score.

reference_rationale: Silero publishes the model only as artifacts inside its own package (TorchScript, ONNX, safetensors); the TorchScript model loaded by load_silero_vad() and the get_speech_timestamps post-processing are the canonical implementation every other port (whisper.cpp, ONNX wrappers) follows. Pinned to silero-vad 6.2.3 on torch 2.8.0, fp32, CPU, 1 thread.
known_risks: Role is VAD (new role, include/transcribe/vad.h), not ASR: acceptance is per-frame speech-probability parity and exact speech-segment parity with get_speech_timestamps, not WER.
Not on Hugging Face: the source checkpoint is the TorchScript file inside the silero-vad 6.2.3 wheel; provenance is the package version plus the file's sha256.
Stateful: an LSTMCell carries (h, c) and the model carries the last 64 samples of the previous frame as context. Frames must be scored in order; offline and streaming share the same recurrence.

Per-frame STFT: each 512-sample frame is scored as [64 context | 512 | 64 reflected] -> 4 STFT windows; the last window of every frame sees reflected samples, not the next frame's audio. The STFT therefore cannot be shared across frames.
The final short frame is zero padded to 512 samples, as get_speech_timestamps does; segment ends are clamped to the real audio length.
8 kHz model (_model_8k) is out of scope: the library's input contract is 16 kHz.

Post-processing (thresholds, min speech / silence, padding, max-speech splitting) is part of the reference contract and is ported verbatim to the role dispatcher, including Python int/float semantics and truthiness of 0 sample positions.
Tiny model (309K params, 1.2 MB F32): quantization buys nothing; ship F32 only.
